definitions.gloss: advance; expansion; entry into (a market, field, or area)
definitions.explanation: Moving forward into a new area, whether in business (entering a new market), sports (advancing to the next round), or other competitive contexts.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}に{進出|しんしゅつ}する{企業|きぎょう}が{増|ふ}えている。
チームは{準決勝|じゅんけっしょう}に{進出|しんしゅつ}した。
examples.english: The team advanced to the semifinals.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{自動車|じどうしゃ}メーカーはアジア{市場|しじょう}への{進出|しんしゅつ}を{加速|かそく}させている。
examples.english: Japanese automakers are accelerating their expansion into Asian markets.

notes:
USAGE NOTES:
{進出|しんしゅつ} implies actively moving into a new sphere of activity. It is most commonly used in business (entering markets) and sports (advancing in tournaments).

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- に{進出|しんしゅつ}する (to advance/expand into...)
- への{進出|しんしゅつ} (expansion into...)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海外|かいがい}{進出|しんしゅつ} (overseas expansion)
- {市場|しじょう}{進出|しんしゅつ} (market entry)
- {決勝|けっしょう}{進出|しんしゅつ} (advancing to the finals)
- {進出|しんしゅつ}を{果|は}たす (to achieve an advance/entry)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{参入|さんにゅう} (market entry) focuses specifically on joining a market or industry. {進出|しんしゅつ} is broader and can cover geographic expansion, sports advancement, or entering new fields.
